component.name: Outlook for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial Microsoft Outlook client for Linux

description.p: Experience seamless integration with Outlook on the web in a standalone Electron application.
This application is an unofficial client for Microsoft Outlook. It is derived from teams-for-linux by Ismael Martinez and remains licensed under the GPL-3.0.

ul.li: First release of this fork, derived from teams-for-linux 2.22.0 and re-pointed at Outlook on the web

Desktop integration carried over from upstream: system notifications, tray icon with unread badge, multiple account profiles, download manager with KDE JobView and Unity LauncherEntry progress, spell checking, client certificates and WebAuthn/FIDO2 sign-in

Teams-only subsystems are disabled rather than deleted: presence and MQTT/Home Assistant, calls and meetings, screen sharing, custom backgrounds and stickers, Teams theme sync, and the msteams: deep-link handler
Linux x64 packages: deb, rpm, tar.gz and AppImage
